blurb: The popes' collections, gathered over five centuries, with the Sistine Chapel at the end of a seven-kilometre walk of galleries.

facts.t: In 1506 Pope Julius II put the newly dug-up Laocoön group on show in a courtyard of the Vatican, a month after it was found in a Roman vineyard. Michelangelo was among the first to see it. That display is counted as the start of the museums.
Raphael painted four rooms of the pope's apartments from 1508, including the School of Athens. He died in 1520 at 37, and his pupils finished the last room.
